newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends firm on crude's big gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends firm on crude's big gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline was slightly stronger on Tuesday as a rally in NYMEX and IPE futures propelled prices higher.
Eurograde barges traded at $210 and $211 fob ARA in late trade, having traded at $207 and $210 earlier.

Traders attributed the later gains to a rally on NYMEX which saw the April crude contract shoot up some 86 cents at $21.78 a barrel by 1854 GMT, dragging IPE May Brent in its wake to trade 76 cents up at $20.26.
April swaps were talked around the $211/$212 level in later trade.
On the cargo front, players continued to monitor the trans-Atlantic arbitrage situation.

Clean tanker brokers reported that a number of vessels suitable for gasoline transportation had been booked on subjects over the past week, but that many had subsequently failed. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
